title: 实现引擎Supervisor与连接状态机

AC04.claim: Release and main-preview remain independent profile identities with fixed commits and expected tool counts.

AC05.claim: Supervisor records transport cancellation, bounded child wait, forced kill, and shutdown receipt outcomes.

AC16.claim: Transport or child timeout is represented as timeout_unknown and is not retried by the lifecycle abstraction.

AC17.claim: Normal cancellation and exit preserve exit code and forced=false in the receipt.

AC18.claim: Forced-kill bookkeeping is covered by deterministic fakes; native process-tree and recovery evidence remains UNVERIFIED.

AC47.claim: Supervisor state is locally managed behind typed IPC; no cloud, real-vault, or raw MCP route was added.

scope_limits: The injected transport seam does not yet connect the product app to the official engine.
T08 and later tasks own user-facing start/stop controls, project routing, and engine capability calls.
P0 bmdock-probe and just contract/contract-main remain independent.
